versions.content: Handling if attempts to collect MACsec statistics at an PHY has been finalized Status: DRAFT If EthTrcv_MacSecGetMacSecStatistics was called for an EthTrcvConfig with EthTrcvMacSecEnabled set to TRUE and the collection of the MACsec statistics for the corresponding PHY has been successfully finalized, then the EthTrcv driver shall perform the following actions: • set all statistics value which are not available (e.g. not provided by the hard- ware) to the maximum value of the used data type (e.g. for uint64 set value to 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF) • notify the EthIf by calling EthIf_MacSecGetMacSecStatisticsNotifica- tion with CtrlIdx set to the corresponding EthIfController Otherwise the EthTrcv driver shall call EthIf_MacSecGetMacSecStatisticsNo- tification with Result set to E_NOT_OK .
